tasks.title: Provision and preserve the console encryption key in shared Compose setups
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior: Host key; secrets-init files and generate modes; Compose. Checks: init-secrets, check-setup rule 7, secrets-init cases and Compose config. Deploy merges first; preserve the existing console and legacy setup e2e. Validate every files-mode input before any write, preserve valid generated keys and refuse invalid existing ones. The minimal setup, image pins, ports, volumes and depends_on stay as specified.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; console-secret-key has mode 600 and 64 lowercase hex characters followed by one newline; a rerun preserves its sha256; rule 7 rejects a missing key; existing symlink and setup checks pass

exit 0; files mode writes secret-key equal to the host value without its newline, owner/mode 1000:1000 400; missing, uppercase or token-equal input fails before any file write with the spec's literal error; no console output directory needs no key; generate mode creates a key, preserves its sha256 on rerun and refuses an invalid existing key without replacing it

acceptance.command: docker compose -f full/compose.yaml config && docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml config && docker compose -f demo/compose.yaml config
acceptance.expected: exit 0; each console has PULSE_CONSOLE_SECRET_KEY_FILE=/run/pulse/secret-key; published ports, volumes and depends_on retain the spec's existing values

acceptance.command: shellcheck -x scripts/init-secrets.sh scripts/init-secrets.test.sh scripts/check-setup.sh scripts/check-setup.test.sh scripts/secrets-init.test.sh && node --check scripts/secrets-init.mjs && bun run check
acceptance.expected: exit 0; shell and helper checks pass and existing CLI lint, typecheck and full tests remain green with at least 80% line coverage

tasks.title: CLI installs create a console key and keep it safely on forced initialization
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior: CLI and Checks: CLI tests. Build on T1's embedded secrets-init helper. Add isSecretKeyContent and KNOWN_FILES coverage; draw the key after tokens and before installId, write it only with console enabled, render the console key env, preserve a valid existing key byte-for-byte on --force, and refuse invalid keys during preflight before any write. Keep the console-disabled minimal render unchanged.

acceptance.command: bun test --coverage cli/tokens.test.ts cli/init.test.ts cli/write-install.test.ts cli/render-compose.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; key content matches ^[0-9a-f]{64}\n$ and mode 600 only with console on; deterministic random draw order matches tokens, key, installId; --force keeps a valid key byte-equal and refuses an invalid one with 'secrets/console-secret-key: is not a valid key (64 lowercase hex characters); fix or remove it' and no writes; rendered console env is /run/pulse/secret-key; minimal without console is unchanged. Focused coverage may miss the global threshold
exit 0; CLI lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with at least 80% line coverage

tasks.title: Deploy supports both setup flows and documents a compatible rollout
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior: e2e/totp.mjs, e2e/console-setup.sh and repository rules; remaining Checks and all Completion evidence. Acceptance 12; Acceptance 13's script side; Rollout order step 1; applicable Security impact checklist. Preserve legacy steps 7-10, detect the flow from Finish setup Location, support auto/legacy/two-factor and fail a forced mismatch. Implement two-factor steps 7-13 with isolated jars, Origin and CSRF, recovery-code reuse rejection, sign out all keeping jar A and ending B/C, restart using the same key, and secret scans. Two-factor execution first occurs in the console child's deploy-dev job, never require an unavailable console feature for this deploy PR. Document key format, upgrade, database/key backup, lost-key recovery, both flows and later release/pin rollout without changing a pin.
